acceptance_predicates.description: Only direct-unshare, systemd-private-network, and bubblewrap-network backends are selectable; arbitrary commands are rejected.
Each backend proves loopback availability and denial of an external connection before any case runs.
Unavailable isolation returns runner_unavailable and never executes a case on the host network.
Timeout, output, workspace, process-group cleanup, and descendant reaping remain enforced for every backend.
The five AR-1597 fault cases pass on direct unshare and at least one approved equivalent backend.
The receipt records exact ASB head, backend/tool identity, preflight, case classifications, cleanup, and network-denial evidence without secrets or private paths.

definition_of_done: Focused unit/integration tests pass for backend selection, preflight, denial, cleanup, and receipt schema.
The five-case matrix passes with an approved equivalent backend where direct unshare is denied.
Exact-head hosted Repository Quality and AWQ checks pass; protected merge and post-merge checks pass.
AR-1596 receives a matrix-linked receipt and is independently requalified or explicitly remains blocked for a separate reason.

inputs.description: Exact ASB development binary under test
Closed isolation backend and validated host capability

gates.description: Backend enum, preflight, and typed unavailable behavior are covered by tests.
All five cases pass with cleanup_ok true and external-network denial proven.
Exact-head PR and post-merge quality gates pass.
